results.expected_summary: Customer is being charged for Pro but isn't receiving Pro features.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about why they are not receiving the premium features of the service despite paying for the pro version. They also mention that they were charged for the pro version at the beginning of the month.

results.expected_summary: Customer is having issues exporting to PDF
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing an issue with exporting a report from Taskflow, with the generation of the PDF failing and taking an indefinite amount of time to complete.

results.expected_summary: Customer reports that search only performs AI search and doesn't search actual notes content.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing issues with searching for their Taskflow notes. The AI search function is not properly recognizing the notes and is not able to look through them directly.

results.expected_summary: Customer reports the app lagging and crashing when handling large attachments.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing lagging and crashing issues when uploading large attachments. They are seeking technical support to resolve the issue.

results.expected_summary: Customer's calendar and reminders are not syncing.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing issues with the calendar and reminders section not syncing, which is a technical problem.

results.expected_summary: Customer is unable to download their data.
results.actual_summary: The customer is unable to save their file on their computer.

results.expected_summary: Notes added on laptop are not syncing to the customer's mobile device.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing difficulty with note synchronization between their laptop and mobile device.

results.expected_summary: Customer's app isn't loading and is asking if there's a server outage.
results.actual_summary: The customer is reporting that their app is not loading, which suggests a technical issue. They are asking for information on the server status and when service will be restored, as they have an important team meeting tomorrow and need their workspace to work.

results.expected_summary: Customer can't cancel their Team subscription before the trial ends and fears being charged.
results.actual_summary: The customer is unable to cancel their Team subscription after the one month free trial, despite clicking the Cancel button, and is concerned that they will be charged for the Team version.

results.expected_summary: Customer's subscription renewal payment failed despite correct card details and wants to avoid a downgrade.
results.actual_summary: The customer received an email that their subscription renewal payment didn't go through, and they are concerned that their account may be downgraded due to the issue. They believe their card details are correct, so they are seeking clarification on what went wrong.

results.expected_summary: Customer was auto-charged after a free trial and is requesting a refund.
results.actual_summary: The customer signed up for a free trial but didn't realize it would automatically charge them later. They would like a refund as they don't want the subscription.

results.expected_summary: Customer was charged full price for both Pro and Team after upgrading mid-cycle.
results.actual_summary: The customer is questioning why they were charged the full amount for both the Pro and Team plans despite upgrading to the Team plan halfway through their billing cycle.

results.expected_summary: Customer's invoice shows charges for more members than they actually have.
results.actual_summary: The customer is disputing a charge on their invoice, claiming they were charged for 5 members when they only have 3 in their workspace. They are requesting a refund.

results.expected_summary: Customer is locked out of their account and never received the password reset email.
results.actual_summary: The customer is having issues logging into their account and resetting their password. They mention that they tried logging in multiple times but were locked out, and they never received the email to reset their password.

results.expected_summary: Customer's team invite feature has stopped working for the second time.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing issues with the team invite feature on their account for the second time. They are requesting support to resolve the issue.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking about plan differences and which one suits a solo user with many projects.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about the differences between our free, pro, and team plans and which one is best suited for their needs, particularly for working alone on multiple projects.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether the Team plan offers more storage than Free and its cost.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking about the data storage capacity of the team plan and the cost associated with it.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking about workspace member limits and extra costs for more members.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking if they can add more than 5 people to their workspace without incurring extra charges.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking what happens to their data, including CSV exports, if they delete their account.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking about what will happen to their data if they delete their account, specifically their CSV documents. They want to know if the data will be deleted or if it will be preserved.

results.expected_summary: Customer is requesting a dark mode feature.
results.actual_summary: The customer is requesting the addition of a dark mode feature to the app, as they find the current light mode to be too visually straining.

results.expected_summary: Customer hasn't received 2FA to log in after 3 days.
results.actual_summary: Customer is waiting for their 2FA code and is concerned about a possible deadline next Monday.

results.expected_summary: Customer gets logged out and loses recurring task settings specifically when configuring them.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing an issue with the recurring task feature in Taskflow, where they are getting logged out mid-setup and their settings are being reset to default. The customer is concerned that this issue may be tied to the recurring task feature and is requesting support to investigate and resolve the problem.

results.expected_summary: Customer's card is being charged twice per cycle for the last two months and wants a refund.
results.actual_summary: The customer is reporting that their card is being charged twice every month for the past two billing cycles, and they are seeking an explanation and a refund of the extra charges.

results.expected_summary: Customer's workspace had team members auto-removed without notice, reducing below their expected plan limit.
results.actual_summary: Customer is inquiring about the number of team members included in their subscription and is concerned about 3 members being automatically removed without notice.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking what counts toward the Free plan's storage limit and whether upgrading would benefit a small team.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about the storage limit on the Free plan and whether upgrading to Pro would provide meaningful improvements for their team size.

results.expected_summary: Customer repeatedly gets an error when attaching files to tasks.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing an issue when trying to add an attachment file to a task on Taskflow, and is receiving an error message. They are requesting urgent resolution.

results.expected_summary: Customer's light/dark mode toggle is bugging out.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing a technical issue with their device, specifically with the screen brightness not working properly. The screen goes dark when the customer wants it to be bright, and vice versa.

results.expected_summary: Customer changed their email address but Taskflow is still sending verification messages to the old email.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about why Taskflow is still sending verification emails to their old email address after they changed it yesterday.

results.expected_summary: Customer cannot reset their password because the password recovery email has not arrived.
results.actual_summary: The customer is unable to retrieve their password through the password recovery option, and is requesting assistance from customer support.

results.expected_summary: Customer is unable to remove a former team member from their workspace.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking for help removing a former team member from their workspace, as they are unable to find the 'remove' option.

results.expected_summary: Customer was unexpectedly logged out of all devices and is being asked to verify their account again.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing unexpected sign-out of Taskflow on all their devices and is being prompted to verify their account again. The customer has not changed their password or security settings, indicating a technical issue with Taskflow.

results.expected_summary: Customer wants to transfer a workspace created under one email account to another account.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking if they can move a workspace they created using their college email to their personal email account.

results.expected_summary: Customer cannot complete two-factor authentication because they no longer have their old phone.
results.actual_summary: The customer has lost their phone which had their 2FA authenticator and is unable to access their account due to the loss of the device. They are seeking help to regain access to their account.

results.expected_summary: Customer can log in but has unexpectedly lost workspace administration permissions.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing technical difficulties with accessing their workspace settings and inviting new members. As the workspace admin, they are unsure of what changed.

results.expected_summary: Customer wants to be granted workspace administrator access.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking where they can change their workspace settings as an admin.

results.expected_summary: Customer's recently received workspace invitation is incorrectly showing as expired.
results.actual_summary: The customer received an invitation to join a company workspace, but the invitation is showing as expired, despite being sent recently.

results.expected_summary: Customer is unable to update their account name because the previous name returns after saving.
results.actual_summary: The customer is having trouble changing their name on their account. They are able to edit their name, see the change in real-time, but it quickly reverts back to their old name.

results.expected_summary: Customer wants to be removed from a former organization's workspace.
results.actual_summary: The customer would like to be removed from a workspace associated with their previous organization, as they no longer require access.

results.expected_summary: Customer cannot accept a workspace invitation because Taskflow incorrectly says they are already a member.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about an issue with an invitation they received from a coworker. They are unable to accept the invitation as it states they are already a member of the workspace, but they have checked their account and the workspace is not present. This suggests a possible billing or account-related issue.

results.expected_summary: Customer reports that the dashboard is stuck loading and does not display any content.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing a delay in loading the dashboard, with the page failing to display any content after approximately ten minutes. They have tried refreshing the page but the issue persists.

results.expected_summary: Customer's PDF uploads repeatedly get stuck at 99% and never complete.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing issues with uploading PDFs, which are not completing the upload process after reaching 99%.

results.expected_summary: Customer is not receiving notifications for comments or task assignments.
results.actual_summary: The customer is no longer receiving notifications for comments or assignments on their tasks, which is impacting their ability to stay updated on their work.

results.expected_summary: Customer's CSV workspace export downloads successfully but contains no data.
results.actual_summary: The customer is experiencing an issue with the exported data not being present in the CSV file. They suspect an issue with the export process.

results.expected_summary: Customer was charged more than their usual subscription amount and wants an explanation for the extra charge.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about an unexpected charge on their credit card. They usually pay a consistent amount each month, but this time there is an additional $20 charge. They did not purchase anything else.

results.expected_summary: Customer was charged after cancelling their subscription and is requesting a refund.
results.actual_summary: The customer cancelled their subscription but was still charged for another billing period, requesting a refund.

results.expected_summary: Customer wants to update their payment card before it expires to prevent a failed subscription renewal.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking if they can update their payment method before their current card expires next month to avoid their subscription renewal failing.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether a student discount is available for the Pro plan.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking if there is a student discount available for purchasing a Pro account.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking what happens to their workspace data after their Team subscription ends.
results.actual_summary: The customer is inquiring about what happens to their workspace data and projects if they discontinue their Team subscription. They want to know if the data remains accessible after the subscription ends.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether the Pro plan has a limit on the number of projects they can create.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking about the maximum number of projects they can create on the Pro plan.

results.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether the same Taskflow account can be used on two computers simultaneously.
results.actual_summary: The customer is asking if they can use the same Taskflow account on multiple devices at the same time without encountering any issues with logins or payments.
